clue.text: Refusal to accept as true bids I feel flawed

clue.text: Bombastic speech, extremely rich, recalled rote initially is cringeworthy

the word read backwards
the first letter of each of the two words

explanation.definitionFit: Rhetoric, in its disparaging sense, is language designed to impress but lacking sincerity: grandiloquent oratory.
